correctness.rationale: Geometrically smooth iff all three Jacobian chart ideals contain 1, proven by the Jacobian criterion and algebraic Nullstellensatz. For every F2 line, quartic restriction is a square iff the two odd-exponent coefficients vanish. Exact 279-orbit partition of 32767 forms, smooth 78 orbits with sum 10920, group orbit weighting gives each six-bin frequency. The separate checker independently enumerates the full 168 invertible group matrices, checks disjoint full coverage, repeats all representative smoothness classifications with another Gröbner order, and verifies bitangent counts on all 10920 smooth forms. All actual proof artifacts are within the finding row.

value.rationale: Rational bitangent lines and Frobenius-fixed canonical contacts are natural finite-field arithmetic statistics on genus-three curves. Exact frequencies across all smooth quartic equations measure how often the rational bitangent obstruction vanishes or occurs over the minimal field, where asymptotic theory is inadequate. The answer includes a complete six-value distribution, not merely a tiny improvement or a known geometric possibility. It provides a reproducible benchmark for arithmetic stratifications; it is not a new moduli classification.
